🎥 Explore Clayton Ranch in Copperas Cove with Kati Bennett!
Thinking about buying a new build? 🏡 Kati takes you on a tour of the beautiful Lennar Homes in Clayton Ranch Subdivision—a growing community with modern features, smart layouts, and builder incentives you won’t want to miss.

Buying directly from a builder might seem simple, but having a real estate agent like Kati in your corner means:
✔️ Expert guidance
✔️ Strong negotiation support
✔️ Help navigating builder contracts
✔️ And best of all—at no extra cost to you as a buyer!

📍 If you're looking for a brand-new home in Copperas Cove, let Kati help you find the perfect fit.

 Kati Bennett, Realtor®
